title: Transfer: Urban PM2.5 Site Decline Ranking
goal: From multi-site PM2.5 observations, aggregate each site to a yearly high-pollution summary, run a trend test per site, and output the site with the steepest statistically significant decline along with its slope and p-value.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the same core workflow to urban air-quality monitoring and adds repeated trend estimation across groups, but success still depends only on computing and comparing site-level trends.
